frequency_question: How often does the Union government formally notify mandated rules within a tight court-ordered deadline (e.g., 30 days) versus seeking extensions or missing the mark?
membership_rule: Includes all instances where the Supreme Court of India set a strict deadline for final notification of subordinate legislation or regulatory rules by a central ministry. Excludes general advisory guidelines without court-ordered deadlines.
